decisions: Burst detection identifies upward frequency jumps at or above an explicit minimum velocity threshold.
Each BurstEvent preserves topic, period, velocity and normalized strength, making the result explainable and period-addressable.
Burst strength is capped at 1.0 and scales as velocity divided by the configured threshold; detection is deterministic and local.
Downward changes, zero changes and sub-threshold changes are not bursts; adaptive baselines are deferred.
risks: The default threshold is a fixed discrete velocity of 2.0 and is not learned from a baseline distribution.
Burst detection inherits the equally spaced-period assumption from TopicDynamics and does not normalize calendar gaps.
